honjo.name: Professor Honjo
honjo.title: A renowned Japanese immunologist and 2018 Nobel laureate in Physiology or Medicine. Special Professor at Kyoto University's Institute for Advanced Study, pioneer of cancer immunotherapy.

points.point1: Discovered PD-1, revealing the T cell immune regulation mechanism
points.point2: Pioneered immunotherapy, proposing blockade of PD-1/PD-L1 to activate anti-cancer immune responses
points.point3: Discovered the AID enzyme, elucidating antibody diversity and immune system adaptation mechanisms
points.point4: Identified IL-4/IL-5, advancing immune and allergic reaction research

gabazza.name: Professor Gabazza Esteban
gabazza.title: Special Professor at Mie University Graduate School of Medicine. Expert in immunology and respiratory medicine, lead developer of CP-101.

points.point1: Discovered Agaricus PD-1, expanding new directions in immune research
points.point2: Extracted CP-101, developing an Agaricus extract with anti-cancer efficacy
points.point3: Authority in immunology research, published over a thousand papers with over 16,000 citations
points.point4: Exploring pulmonary immune mechanisms, promoting chronic lung disease and immune-related treatment research

okada.name: Kunihiko Okada
okada.title: Authority in Japan's regenerative medicine field, Master from Tokushima University, PhD from Nagoya University, Chairman of DRAQUA and REBOR among other bio-medical enterprises. Leading cutting-edge research in stem cell culture, bone regeneration and tissue engineering, promoting clinical applications of regenerative medicine.

ding.name: Ming Yue Ding
ding.title: Professor and doctoral supervisor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology School of Life Science and Technology. Expert in high-end biomedical imaging, long devoted to innovation in medical devices and imaging technology.

yan.name: Wei Yan
yan.title: Expert in medical health management, internist. Graduated from Xiangya School of Medicine (Central South University) and Guanghua School of Management (Peking University), with over 20 years of experience in the medical industry, participating in multiple 1.1 class new drug clinical trials.

mie.name: Mie University
